root_causes.description: The quote service (leaf dependency of shipping) is the origin of the incident: its server request rate is zero and its p99 latency histogram yields no samples across the window, while error rate, CPU and restart count are all flat and the pod stays alive — indicating requests are stuck in-flight due to an injected latency fault rather than failing or crashing. That stall propagates up shipping → checkout → frontend, where p99 saturates at ~10 s.

root_causes.description: Shipping is the direct caller of quote and the first upstream hop where the stall manifests; its server latency also yields no completed data and it emits no errors, consistent with blocking on the stalled quote dependency rather than a local fault.

evidence.observed_value: no data returned (no completed server latency samples)

root_causes.description: Checkout is an upstream victim: its p99 is pinned at the 10 s ceiling with negligible error rate, reflecting checkout blocking on the shipping → quote call path rather than a local resource fault.

remediation_steps: Inspect the quote pod for an injected latency fault (tc/netem delay or application-level sleep); it stays alive with flat CPU/memory/restarts yet completes zero requests.
Capture the shipping → quote client-side spans and add a quote client-latency histogram so the blocked dependency becomes directly measurable.

Restart/redeploy the quote service to clear stuck in-flight requests and shed the latency injection, then confirm quote request_rate and p99 return to baseline and checkout/frontend p99 drop from 10 s.
